title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation in a Chronos-Interpreter Gist of Chronos-Continuum Concurrency Structure
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: The Gist of Chronos-Continuum introduces a balanced search and indexing structure that guarantees logarithmic point and range query performance while preserving strict height-balance and key-ordering invariants under concurrent modifications. The design leverages a fine-grained lock hierarchy and a bounded buffer for inter-thread coordination, implemented in pure Chronos-Interpreter. Formal analysis demonstrates that each insertion or deletion triggers at most $O(\log N)$ rebalancing steps, and the overall structure remains height-balanced with $h \le \lceil \log_2(N+1) \rceil$. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms a source-line count of 287 and 29 function blocks, matching the theoretical complexity profile. No empirical runtime measurements are reported; the evaluation is purely static. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_050218_gist_of_aether-continuum__conc}
